summary: REQ-1 appears implemented: Notes page now defines the four new category tabs (LDC, Food Service, Personal, Family) in the categories array and filters notes by exact category match. For REQ-2/REQ-3, the modal’s TypeScript category union includes the new categories and edit mode sets category from the note, but the diff is truncated before showing the actual SelectItem dropdown options—so it’s not verifiable that the Add/Edit modal dropdown UI contains the four new selectable options.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add Note modal Category select includes new options: LDC, Food Service, Personal, Family, while keeping all existing options unchanged.
missing_requirements.reason: Although the CategoryOption type includes the four new categories, the diff is truncated before the modal's SelectContent/SelectItem rendering, so there is no evidence the dropdown UI actually exposes these new options.

missing_requirements.requirement: Edit Note modal Category select includes new options and preselects existing notes with those categories; saving works without validation/type errors.
missing_requirements.reason: The effect sets category from noteToEdit and the type includes the new categories, but the diff is truncated before the SelectItem list and any edit-mode preselection/rendering behavior can be verified from the UI code.

hallucinated_features.description: Custom toast styling for note create/update success messages (background color via OKLCH and text color).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest explicitly constrained changes to adding four category options/tabs only; toast styling changes are unrelated to category additions.
